text.p: BNP-Dresdner Bank (Hungaria) Rt on Friday reported its IAS consolidated profits surging 76 percent last year over 1995.
The bank's net operating profit soared to 1.228 billion forints in 1996, up from 679.5 million in 1995, rising 76.05 percent, the bank said in a statement.
Its net profit after taxation soared to one billion forints in 1996 from 570.9 million in 1995, up 76.2 percent, it said.
Consumer price inflation averaged 23.6 percent in 1996, according to Central Statistical Office (KSH) figures.
BNP-Dresdner Bank (Hungaria) Rt is 50-50 percent owned by Banque Nationale de Paris and Dresdner Bank AG .
Of the profits, 250 million will be paid as dividend, 198 million will be transferred to general reserves while 63.3 million to capital reserves.
The bank's loan portfolio rose to 22.20 billion forints in 1996 from 14.46 billion in 1995, it said.
The bank's balance sheet total grew to 50.70 billion forints in 1996 from 35.25 billion the year before, it said. Its capital adequacy ratio was 18 percent.
